name: Juan Fernandez Petrel
rangeDescription: Alejandro selkirk island (=mas afuera, juan fernández islands; far west of central chile)
description: Large, rather long-tailed, and relatively big-billed petrel of offshore subtropical and tropical waters in the eastern and central Pacific; not seen from mainland. Named for Juan Fernandez Islands in Chile, where the species breeds.
imageCreditName: Fernando Díaz I Albatross Birding Chile

name: Nilgiri Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Foothill forest of southwestern peninsular india (mysore southward to kerala)
description: Entirely indigo-blue male is unique; Verditer Flycatcher is brighter blue and more elongated. Female Nilgiri is gray overall, though can sometimes show a bluish tinge in good lighting.

name: Magpie Starling
rangeDescription: Sudan to southern ethiopia, somalia, northeastern uganda, kenya, and tanzania
description: An unusual and distinctive starling of dry country. Males are dark above and white below, with a blue-black hood and upperparts; females are dark gray.

name: Tibetan Bunting
rangeDescription: Western china (borders of arid tibet, southwestern qinghai, and sichuan)
description: Handsome thickset bunting restricted to a small part of the eastern Qinghai-Tibetan plateau where it inhabits scrubby slopes above the timberline. Unmistakable in its range; no other bunting in the area combines its size, brick-orange back, and gray belly.

name: Eastern Double-collared Sunbird
rangeDescription: Highlands of kenya and northern tanzania
description: A medium-sized sunbird. Males are colorful, red and green, and females drab brownish.

name: Hooded Merganser
rangeDescription: Breeds northern north america; winters to mexico and west indies
description: Small diving duck with thin serrated bill. Breeding males have showy black-and-white crest, a couple zebra stripes on the white breast, and cinnamon-colored sides.

name: Iraq Babbler
rangeDescription: Southern türkiye, syria, iraq, and southwestern iran (reedbeds of tigris-euphrates valley)
description: Small babbler with a long tail and short wings, typical of other babblers. Warm buff overall with a pale throat and a lightly streaked back and crown.

name: Semicollared Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Montane forest of balkan peninsula to northwestern iran; winters in eastern africa
description: Very similar to other black-and-white small flycatchers. Male differs from Collared and Pied Flycatchers in thinly connected black crown and mantle, and white median coverts.

name: Arfak Astrapia
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (arfak mountains); sight record from tamrau mountains
description: A long-tailed bird of montane forest canopy. Male has much longer tail with iridescent green belly, black chest and small, iridescent blue throat patch.

name: Przevalski's Pinktail
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china and eastern tibet
description: The Przevalksi’s Pinktail is the only member of its family. It looks like a cross between a rosefinch and a bunting, but it isn’t closely related to either.

name: White-naped Swift
rangeDescription: Mountains of western mexico (chihuahua to nayarit, hidalgo, and morelos)
description: Very large, spectacular swift of highlands in west Mexico, also descending locally to foothills and lowlands. Often in flocks, at times of hundreds, especially around waterfalls and other roosting sites.

name: Malagasy Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Madagascar and aldabra; post-breeding dispersal to central africa
description: Chunky, short-legged heron. All white with a black-tipped blue bill and bright red legs in breeding plumage.

name: Bush Blackcap
rangeDescription: Eastern south africa (southward to central eastern cape) and western eswatini
description: A large warbler that is remarkably bulbul-like, pale gray-buff below and olive-brown above with an orange-pink bill and a black cap that extends below the eye. The juvenile is duller.

name: Plain White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of yap (northwestern caroline islands)
description: This small warbler-like bird is unremarkable in appearance, but surely not the plainest of the white-eyes; look for a pale eye with a very narrow white eyering, grayish upperparts, and contrasting pale yellow throat. Endemic to the island of Yap, in the Western Caroline Islands of Micronesia, where it inhabits a wide range of forested and brushy habitats.

name: Nilgiri Pipit
rangeDescription: Montane grassland of southwestern india (western tamil nadu and kerala)
description: Warm buff-brown pipit with prominent white eyebrow and strong dense streaking all over the back; breast is more finely and sparsely marked. Much more well-marked above than other local pipits.

name: Taiwan Shortwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of taiwan
description: A small, dark songster of montane forest floor and undergrowth. Note dark brown body with a fairly bold white eyebrow.

name: Rufous-throated Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northern australia (fitzroy river, western australia to noosa, queensland)
description: Small honeyeater with a distinctive red-brown throat patch, white underparts, gray head, brown back, and yellow wing patch. Juveniles lack the rusty throat patch but may have traces of reddish coloration.

name: Caucasian Grouse
rangeDescription: Caucasus mountains, from far southwestern russia eastward to northeastern azerbaijan and southward to northeastern turkey, armenia, and far northwestern iran
description: Large gamebird endemic to the mountains of the Caucasus region. Male is jet-black with a tiny white patch on the shoulder, a tail that curves downwards at the tip, and flaming red “eyebrows.” White underwing patches are displayed during jumping lekking display.

name: Rufous-sided Scrub-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southern suriname and eastern brazil to northeastern bolivia and northeastern paraguay
description: Tiny flycatcher with a long tail. Note the white throat contrasting with the brown back, yellowish belly, and cinnamon flanks.

name: Red-throated Swallow
rangeDescription: Gabon and south-central democratic republic of the congo to angola and northwestern zambia
description: A small, stocky, martin-like swallow that has dark upperparts mottled around the hindneck and back, rusty throat with an indistinct partial dark collar, and a paler buffy belly. In flight, rusty rump and white blotches in the tail are distinctive.
